design.question: Can changing local push membership and closing the estimated 2D goal error improve the fixed multishape task?

methods.cvt: Unchanged boundary CVT and original transport
methods.spacing: Unchanged spacing predeployment and original transport
methods.push_cone: Existing pre-CONTACT_READY trailing-cone target, original transport
methods.adaptive_arc: CVT; membership uses existing steered direction rather than original task axis
methods.vector_cvt: CVT; local/one-hop credible 2D displacement median, point-goal feedback, adaptive membership and matching ring direction
methods.vector_spacing: Same vector feedback with existing spacing predeployment

fixed: settled rule HOLD and speed <= .005 for 40 frames
changed_vector: Full-vector one-hop feedback, no unseen neighbors
Relative goal delta only; no simulator pose
Control arrival tube uses each frozen config existing cross_track_deadband (.02 m here); new controller policy, not the independent .12 m evaluation tolerance
HOLD requires estimated 2D tube and existing speed gate
Scalar local hold latch may clear before shared HOLD so a changed local estimate can recover
PI retained through braking below desired speed; no quorum-based loss of integral in vector arm
Density offsets and normal membership face current estimated goal after CONTACT_READY
design.negative_results: All planned and launched cases, errors, timeouts, safety events and lost prior successes retained; no tuning/retry to success
design.promotion: No default promotion on this reused development seed. Report gained/lost tasks vs both references, endpoint changes, hard safety and information cost.
stage_order: analyze both horizons and all failures
limitations: No attachment or force sensor added
One-hop vector messages are explicit added communication relative to scalar vote
Shared all-team estimated phase supervisor remains; not fully decentralized
Geometry/parameter conditions share one development seed, no independent reliability claim

evaluation.completion: Original HOLD + speed <= .005 for 40 frames AND final Euclidean error <= .12 m
evaluation.horizon: Use saved trajectory at 150 s for unended runs; completion time only for tasks already terminated successfully
evaluation.censoring: Unfinished at 600 s is right-censored; early off-target HOLD is separately reported
evaluation.safety: Original separation, clearance, penetration and QP failure checks; scaling events separately reported
evaluation.comparisons: All six methods paired within the same nine geometry/direction conditions; no independent reliability estimate
evaluation.gate: No default promotion on this reused development seed; a promising candidate gains >=2 completions vs both controls, loses <=1, and introduces no hard safety violations
evaluation.error_policy: Every planned/launched case remains in denominator; errors, timeouts, regressions and budget cutoffs retained

information.local: Own boundary map and one-hop fresh credible displacement/velocity messages
information.shared: All-team estimate used for common phase only; not fully decentralized
information.truth: Only unchanged sensor/physics/independent evaluation paths; never in new navigation functions
information.communication: Vector arms expose two displacement floats per live directed neighbor link each frame; baseline scalar progress is one
